integrity: New analytical statement with symbolic reproducibility and explicit named literature caveats; no independent validation or historical priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Complete double-ended basin classification is restricted to 4<k<=16/3 in a one-parameter cubic specialization. Claims above 16/3 concern only existence of period two, not complete basins. Uniform initial-state probability is geometric; earlier 2009/2019 complete prior texts were unavailable; broader priority unresolved.
title: Exact extinction basins and the sharp no-two-cycle window for a cubic Allee map
